challenge.better_approach: Leave the bash beside the .py: rejected, two launchers drift (measured: the .py was ported from the bash and its docstring says the bash 'stays until bin/cairn dispatch', which child 5 PROVED).
challenge.hidden_assumption: That every bash-only tooth has a Python counterpart: measured not true for test_superclaude_bare_box (sudo askpass, install of an absent claude), which the .py's tooth 7 contradicts by forbidding sudo prompts; the ticket must name those, not assume them.
challenge.prior_art: Checked in-house: cairn codemother retire (ticket 750ead1af9c1) finds callers by running proofs before and after; ticket b33cc7d29c45 already owns test_a_launch_moves_off_a_held_instance.py and is left out; 1941e93b25a3 built the port.
challenge.real_collision: None with a Law; the bare-box askpass teeth and tooth 7 of test_superclaude_runs_from_python are two contracts about sudo, and the proof of the newer one (outline 10.3.2.1, no sudo on Windows) is the one that survives.

answers.falsifier: `cairn codemother retire cairn/devices/cc/superclaude` exits RETIRED on Linux with no CALLER named; the repointed proofs read green against superclaude.py; every bash-only tooth is either replaced by a named tooth or listed as dropped with its reason.
answers.from_idea: none, because it is child 6 of ticket c3cd232ba0cf (CairnCommons/tickets/c3cd232ba0cf-*.json, its `how` lists the proof moves) and outline 10.3.2.1 says superclaude is Python on every box; children 1941e93b25a3 and 0b7a3f1d53f0 are PROVED
answers.how: One Linux-built ticket: repoint cc/0/bin/restart and recovery/bootstrap.sh to superclaude.py; for each of the proofs that run the bash, repoint it to the .py or retire its teeth against the matching tooth of test_superclaude_runs_from_python.py (a tooth with no replacement is named, not dropped silently); run `cairn codemother retire cairn/devices/cc/superclaude` on Linux; fix the charter and comment wording that names the bash.
answers.traces_to: Law 1 (the settled answer is not re-derived: two launchers is two answers), Law 4 (the retire door is the physics that finds the callers), and outline 10.3.2.1 (superclaude is Python on every box).
answers.what: The bash launcher cairn/devices/cc/superclaude is retired: every caller and proof that ran it moves to cairn/devices/cc/superclaude.py or is retired against a named replacement tooth, and the file is deleted through `cairn codemother retire`.

bullets.text: Measured 2026-11-23 at origin/main ee12953c6: the retire machine's namers() finds 20 files naming the bash; 14 are Linux-run proofs or Linux scripts, so the build is a Linux hand's and the chart waits for one (constrain runs recovery's and cc's proofs).
test_a_launch_moves_off_a_held_instance.py is owned by ticket b33cc7d29c45 and is outside this ticket.
